name: SramCheck_Bank0PageSum
evidence: A bit0 = page: sums the first $FFE bytes of SRAM bank 0 page $A000 or $B000 into DE (16-bit additive) and returns HL = stored checksum word at page+$FFE; runs at boot (frame ~324) in 40 of 41 scenarios

name: SramCheck_Bank0StorePageSum
evidence: Stores DE at page+$FFE/$FFF (low byte first) of SRAM bank 0 page A bit0 ($AFFE/$BFFE)

name: SramCheck_CompareDEHL
evidence: Compares HL with DE: A=0 if equal, A=$FF if different (duplicate at 22:5093)

name: SramCheck_Bank0ClearPage
evidence: Zero-fills the $1000 bytes of SRAM bank 0 page A bit0 ($A000 or $B000)

name: SramCheck_Bank0CopyPage
evidence: Copies the $1000-byte SRAM bank 0 page A bit0 to the other page (destination high byte = source xor $10): page 0 -> mirror page 1 or back

name: SramCheck_VerifyAndRepairAll
evidence: Save check: page 0 ok -> mirror to page 1; else page 1 ok -> restore page 0; else clear both; then bank 1 block check (5035/5093, 50A0 clears if bad); callers Startup_SaveDataError (65:418A)/41A9/4226, 48:49F8, 68:4DB4; boot_states

name: SramCheck_RestorePage0

name: SramCheck_MirrorPage0
evidence: Page 0 good: copy page 0 over page 1 (22:4F7B with A=0)

name: SramCheck_Bank0Status
evidence: Returns A=1 if SRAM bank 0 page 0 checksum is good, 0 if only page 1 is good, $FF if both are bad (no repair); called by Startup_VerifySaveData (65:416C)/41A9
